iWantTo: see batch and serial numbers as separate, distinct fields in stock detail and list views
soThat: I can identify and inspect individual stock items by their unique tracking attributes.

independence.rationale: This is the user-facing (E2E UI) story that makes batch and serial visible to operators. The database migration (S1–S2) can be complete with inventory_code dropped, but the UI still displays only the old combined code (or nothing). This story delivers the distinct behavior: the operator sees batch and serial broken out in the interface.
